boundary: Fetching public documentation does not authorize authentication, tenant discovery, mutation, vulnerability testing, or access to any non-public surface.

directives.search: robots.txt allows canonical public routes and disallows excluded paths
directives.retrieval: named user-triggered retrieval agents may fetch canonical public routes
